title: Whips (Core): lash hits along the path, damage falloff, minion tag and focus
player_outcome: Whips crack out along a lash, hitting every enemy on the way (less damage per extra enemy). They tag what they strike: your minions switch to the tagged enemy and deal bonus tag damage to it. Snapthorn poisons.
design: Verified: leather_whip and snapthorn are meleeSwing arcs. There is no whip/tag code; minions target the nearest NPC to the owner (ProjectileSystem.Special.cs:104-112).
ItemBehaviorSpecs 'whip' → WhipParams { Length (cells), Segments (20), TagBuff (buff id), TagDamage (int), Falloff (0.3) }. ItemAction.Whip; UseStyleRules maps Whip → Whip (not Melee).

New Core Gameplay/Entities/WhipGeometry.cs: pure Points(t, origin, forward, up, length, segments). A quadratic bezier animated over t: the lash winds back and up until 0.35, sweeps forward and is fully extended along the aim at t 0.6, then snaps. Shared with the renderer.

New Core Gameplay/Entities/WhipSystem.cs: ItemUseSystem raises Whipped(p, info); each active lash lasts UseAnimationMax. Each tick, test the segment points against NPC volumes; each NPC is hit once per crack, with damage × (1 − Falloff)^hitsSoFar.
On hit: apply TagBuff through NpcSystem.AddBuff and set Npc.TaggedBy = owner and Npc.TagTick. Snapthorn also applies 'poisoned' via its projectile-style onHit list (WhipParams.OnHit TypedSpec[]).
EffectSpecs 'minionTag' → MinionTagParams { Damage }; EffectState exposes MinionTagDamage.
ProjectileSystem.TickMinion prefers the owner's most recently tagged live NPC within Range×1.5.
HitCreatures adds the target's MinionTagDamage when the projectile is a minion or was fired by one (Projectile.FromMinion set in TickMinion's Spawn).
Repeat rule in ItemUseSystem: whips do not auto-repeat unless the Autoswing stat (P3-15) is > 0.
